data.narrative:
Curio Solutions is a Series A-stage nuclear energy company founded by Ed McGinnis and Pete Zweifel that has raised $16M+. The valuation landscape in nuclear energy comprises 3 public comps (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy, though the private cohort spans heterogeneous stages and valuations.

Stage-progression methodology applies to Curio, using the $16M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage transitions, yielding $32M. A peer-median approach is not reliable here: while 4 same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints satisfy narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier valuation), and applying an all-sector median would obscure nuclear-specific dynamics. Accordingly, only the stage-progression method grounds this analysis.

The triangulated valuation range is $27M (low) to $37M (high), with a central estimate of $32M. This range reflects the single applicable methodology and inherent uncertainty around pre-revenue stage comparables and the sparse, dispersed nuclear energy private markets. Key risks to valuation include technology maturation timelines, regulatory pathway clarity, and the illiquidity discount warranted by early-stage nuclear ventures. Given the single-method foundation, this range should be treated as illustrative rather than definitive pending access to deeper transaction or financial data.
